title: RVanDamme/muffin pipeline parameters
description: Metagenomics workflow for hybrid assembly, differential coverage binning, metatranscriptomics and pathway analysis

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet (CSV) with the reads of each sample.
input.help_text: Columns: `sample,short_reads_1,short_reads_2,long_reads,rna_reads_1,rna_reads_2`. Each sample needs a short-read pair, long (ONT) reads, or both; the pipeline derives the mode (short, long or hybrid) per sample. The RNA columns are optional. Required unless `--input_bins` is used.

coverage_input.description: Samplesheet (CSV) of extra read sets used only for differential-coverage binning.
coverage_input.help_text: Columns: `sample,short_reads_1,short_reads_2,long_reads`. Every row is mapped to every assembly and added to the binner's coverage input.

input_bins.description: Samplesheet (CSV) of existing bins to classify and annotate.
input_bins.help_text: Columns: `sample,bins_dir`. Skips read QC, assembly and binning for these samples; the pipeline starts at bin quality control.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

workflow_control_options.title: Workflow control options
workflow_control_options.description: Choose which parts of the pipeline run.

skip_assembly.description: Skip read QC, assembly and binning.

skip_classification.description: Skip taxonomic classification of bins and unbinned reads.

skip_annotation.description: Skip functional annotation (eggNOG-mapper) and the PANKEGG database.

read_qc_options.title: Read quality control options
read_qc_options.description: Read filtering with fastp (short reads) and chopper (long reads).

longread_min_length.description: Minimum long-read length kept by chopper (`-l`).

longread_min_quality.description: Minimum mean long-read quality kept by chopper (`-q`).

assembly_options.title: Assembly and polishing options
assembly_options.description: Short-read samples are assembled with metaSPAdes and long-read samples with metaFlye; these options cover hybrid samples and polishing.

hybrid_assembler.help_text: `metaspades`: hybrid metaSPAdes on short and long reads. `metaflye`: metaFlye on long reads, polished with racon and medaka, then bins polished with short reads (Pilon).

medaka_model.help_text: Leave unset to let medaka choose the model from the read headers. Set it when the basecaller information is missing from the reads.

pilon_rounds.description: Number of Pilon polishing rounds on bins (hybrid samples assembled with metaFlye).

binning_options.title: Binning and bin quality options
binning_options.description: Binning, CheckM2 quality control and bin filtering.

semibin_mode.description: SemiBin2 model: a pretrained environment model (`pretrained`) or self-supervised training on the sample (`self`).
semibin_mode.help_text: The semi-supervised mode of MUFFIN v1 (`--bining_model semi`) is deprecated in SemiBin2 and is not offered.

semibin_environment.description: SemiBin2 pretrained environment (used with `--semibin_mode pretrained`), for example `global`, `human_gut`, `soil`, `ocean`.

checkm2_db.description: Path to the CheckM2 DIAMOND database (`.dmnd`).
checkm2_db.help_text: Required for bin quality control unless `--download_checkm2_db` is set.

bin_min_score.description: Bins are kept when `Completeness - 5 x Contamination` is above this value.

skip_bin_filter.description: Keep all bins regardless of their CheckM2 score.

taxonomy_options.title: Taxonomic classification options
taxonomy_options.description: Classification of bins and of reads that do not map to any good bin.

bin_taxonomy.help_text:
`sourmash` (default): `sourmash gather` + `sourmash tax genome`; minutes per bin, a few GB of RAM, database around 10 GB. Needs `--sourmash_db` and `--sourmash_lineages`.

`sourmash_lca`: `sourmash lca classify`, the MUFFIN v1 method, kept for continuity with old results; the LCA database format is deprecated upstream. Needs `--sourmash_lca_db`.

`gtdbtk`: GTDB-Tk `classify_wf`, the most accurate method and the community standard. **Heavy:** the reference data takes on the order of 100 GB of disk, the run needs tens of GB of RAM and typically hours per sample. Needs `--gtdbtk_db`.

sourmash_db.help_text: Used by `--bin_taxonomy sourmash` and by the classification of unbinned reads.

download_sourmash_db.description: Download the sourmash GTDB database and lineages (about 10 GB).

sourmash_lca_db.description: sourmash LCA database (`.lca.json` or `.lca.json.gz`), only for `--bin_taxonomy sourmash_lca`.

gtdbtk_db.description: GTDB-Tk reference data (directory or `.tar.gz`), only for `--bin_taxonomy gtdbtk`.
gtdbtk_db.help_text: On the order of 100 GB on disk; classification needs tens of GB of RAM.

skip_unbinned_read_classification.description: Skip the classification of reads that do not map to the good bins.

annotation_options.title: Functional annotation options
annotation_options.description: eggNOG-mapper annotation of bins and transcripts.

eggnog_data_dir.help_text: Required for annotation unless `--download_eggnog_db` is set.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
